transcript: If all of my accounts got wiped out today, if they took every dollar and left me with just a laptop, wifi, $500 to my name, do you know what I'll do right now? I follow the exact same game plan that got me here in the first place. The same one that Wall Street Academy members are following right now. First, I would not rush into market. I spend seven days mastering just one high probability setup that shows up consistently and fits my psychology. Next, I treat the $500 like it was a half a million dollars, no overleveraging, no revenge trading, no YOLO moves, just small consistent wins that build up my confidence. Then I'll focus on flipping the account once, using proper risk management to get over $1 ,000 so I could qualify for a prop funding firm. Then once I'm funded, it's game on from there. It's not about having a huge account to start up. It's about taking the right steps with the right systems and then the right mindset. So if you wanna learn this exact system, DM me game plan and I'll send it right over.
